Narsha is a controller app dedicated for GlucoMen Day PUMP users to deliver insulin and manage diabetes.
The Narsha app can be installed on your personal smart device to easily operate and control the Patch wirelessly via Bluetooth anytime, anywhere.
Are you a GlucoMen Day PUMP user? Download Narsha now.

[Main functions of the Narsha]

- Insulin delivery using a Patch
Using the Narsha app, you can set up a personalized basal delivery program and send various commands to the Patch to deliver bolus, suspend insulin delivery, etc.
You can set up a 24-hour basal program or temporarily adjust the basal rate depending on your situation.
You can simply calculate the amount of bolus by entering your current blood glucose and carbohydrate. You also have the option to deliver some of the bolus later(extended bolus) to accomodate certain meals. 

- Data analysis of insulin and blood glucose
The '24 hrs' menu provides a graph and summary of the last 24 hours of blood glucose, the amount of bolus delivery, basal delivery, carbohydrate intake, and exercise time. 
In the 'Trend' menu, you can view hourly graphs and statistics for blood glucose and the amount of bolus/basal by selecting the desired date range.
You can also view a detailed history of all accumulated data for the last 90 days in the 'History' menu.

- The insulin delivery data stored in Narsha can be viewed on the GlucoLog Web.
